//: Declaration emit for the consumable package. The root tsconfig.json is the TYPE GATE (`tsc --noEmit` over src + .storybook); it cannot emit, because with no `rootDir` set TypeScript infers the common source directory and fails with TS5011, and its `include` would drag 168 stories, 22 tests and 11 node-checks into dist/. This config fixes both: rootDir pins the tree at src/ so dist/ mirrors it 1:1, and the exclusions below keep the docs/test layer out of the shipped types.
